title: One market, two loss limits
hook: The same toy opportunity faces two organizations. What changes when failure costs differ?

knows: basic arithmetic and the meaning of a percentage
doesNotKnow: Explain why a fixed opportunity can clear one stipulated loss budget and fail another.

misconception: The same market prize gives every organization the same incentive to pursue it.
objective: Explain why a fixed opportunity can clear one stipulated loss budget and fail another.
